description: Create or update customers in the partner master (max 500 per call) — for customer lists that don't arrive via import_historical_sales_orders. Matched by email (case-insensitive) first, falling back to exact name — so a row with an email still converges onto an existing same-name partner and enriches it. Besides contact details a row can set vatIdNumber, customerSegment (individual | distributor | other) and a default taxRate. A match that is currently only a vendor is upgraded in place (enabled_customer) since partners are one entity with role flags. Preserve-on-omit updates; validateOnly=true dry-runs every row. An optional per-row customFields map (see list_custom_fields, entity=businessPartner) writes tenant-defined field values; an unknown fieldName fails just that row. Partial success with per-row errors; resubmitting is safe. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token — the partner master is tenant-shared.

customers.description: Customer rows to create/update (max 500). name is required per row.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by fieldName (see list_custom_fields, entity=businessPartner — vendors and customers share the businessPartner entity). Merged per key: omitted keys keep their value, an explicit null clears one. list fields take an option id or name; multilist an array of them. Unknown fieldNames fail the row.

customerSegment.description: Customer segment: individual | distributor | other. Forecasting and rules use it, for example to dampen distributor bulk orders. New customers default to individual. Omit to preserve.

taxRate.description: Default sales tax rate for this customer: id, code or name from list_tax_rates. "" clears it. Omit to preserve.

vatIdNumber.description: VAT identification number. Omit to preserve.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate + probe every row and report the would-be action per row, writing nothing.
